original.title: Recrutement d'un conducteur de véhicule adminitratif 2 pour le compte de Aviculture

response.body_en:
Republic of Benin
****
Ministry of Small and Medium Enterprises and Employment Promotion
****
National Employment Agency
****

CALL FOR APPLICATIONS

Reference: __________ /25/ of_____ December 2025

December 2025

The National Employment Agency (AnpE) recruits on behalf of a Project and a program the following profiles.

POSITIONS TO BE FILLED
Specialist in Environmental and Social Safeguards
Specialist in Environmental Safeguards
Specialist in Childcare Services
Specialist in Monitoring and Evaluation
Expert in Aviculture
Specialist in Marketing, Sales and Marketing in Agriculture/Aviculture
Team Assistant
Administrative Vehicle Driver

GENERAL APPLICATION CONDITIONS
Be of Beninese nationality;
Be of good moral character.

DOCUMENTS TO BE PROVIDED

A motivation letter written in French and addressed to the Project Coordinator;
A simple copy of the nationality certificate;
A complete Curriculum Vitae (05 pages maximum, written in Arial font, size 12) specifying the experience gained and three reference persons;
Simple copies of work certificates from the different positions held or any supporting documents;
Simple copies of required diplomas;
A certified copy of the driving license (only for the CVA position).

NB: Additional documentation will be requested from short-listed candidates.

SELECTION PROCESS

The selection process for each of the open positions will take place in three (03) phases:
Pre-selection based on review of application files;
Selection through interview (interview of pre-selected candidates);
Negotiation of the employment contract with the candidate(s) retained for each position following the interview.

GENERAL CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

Selected candidate(s) will have the status of consultant(s). Consultants will be selected in accordance with the procedures defined in the Procurement Regulations for Borrowers Seeking Project Financing (FPI) of July 2016, with the latest revision dating from September 2025.

It is understood that the recruitment of a government official must satisfy the provisions of clause 3.23 d) of the Procurement Regulations for Borrowers Seeking Project Financing (FPI) of July 2016, revised in November 2017, August 2018, November 2020, September 2023, February 2025 and September 2025, which specify that government representatives and officials of the Borrower's country may be hired for contracts concerning consulting services, on an individual basis or as members of a consulting firm's expert team only when (i) their services are of a unique and exceptional nature, or their participation is indispensable to project implementation; (ii) their engagement will not create conflicts of interest; and (iii) their engagement does not violate any law, regulation or policy of the Borrower.

CONFLICT OF INTEREST

Candidates must be free of any risk of conflicts of interest, that is, not be owner or stakeholder in the boards of directors or management bodies of: firms, studies offices, enterprises, companies likely to be interested in the calls for tenders and consultations that will result from contracts financed by the Project.

CONTRACT DURATION AND CHARACTERISTICS OF POSITIONS

The contract duration for each position to be filled will be one (1) year renewable subject to satisfactory annual evaluation of performance and until the end of the project, after a probationary period of three (03) months during the first year.

All positions are based in Cotonou, with possibilities for missions within the country.

CONDUCTOR (CONDUCTRICE) DE VEHICULE ADMINISTRATIF

DESCRIPTION OF TASKS

Under the hierarchical supervision and functional authority of the Project Coordinator, the Administrative Vehicle Driver has the mission to drive the project vehicles in the best safety conditions.

The Administrative Vehicle Driver will be responsible for the following activities:
Ensure the movement of administrative personnel, managers and delegations of the Funder, in compliance with traffic regulations;
Ensure the safety of vehicles, persons and goods transported;
Maintain the project vehicle fleet and perform minor repairs of vehicles in this fleet;
Monitor the regularity of necessary administrative documents (insurance, technical inspection...);
Establish and keep updated the register of use of project vehicles indicating in particular various consumption (fuel, lubricants, tires, etc.);
Drive, assist and guide at the level of all public administrations, large public or private enterprises and in the main cities of Benin, external support, control or audit missions of the project;
Perform, under the supervision of the Financial Management Specialist, material and logistical arrangements (related to the vehicle) necessary for the organization of field missions, workshops, training seminars and meetings related to project activities.
Perform any other task that falls within the scope of the exercise of his/her functions, in accordance with these Terms of Reference.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

The position of Administrative Vehicle Driver is open to all Beninese candidates meeting the following conditions.

Profile

Hold a category B driving license.
Have obtained the BEPC at minimum.

Fundamental Professional Experience

Have at least five (5) years of professional experience in vehicle driving in an administration, company or in a development project with national coverage.

Complementary Experience

Have good knowledge of all Departments of Benin, particularly the Departments of the North;
Experience in a government agency (including Funds) or on other projects financed by Development Institutions/Organizations (Multilateral Development Banks (African Development Bank, World Bank, IDB, CIDB, WADB, etc.) would be an asset;
Have knowledge of automotive mechanics would be an asset.

Aptitudes

Have perfect audio-visual acuity;
Be discreet, courteous and honest;
Be very clean;
Have experience with long-distance trips at night as well as during the day;
Be able to speak and write in French.

DEPOSIT AND CLOSING DATE FOR APPLICATIONS

Complete application files containing required documents must be submitted online at the following address https://recruitbenin.bj/, no later than ....... December 2025 at 12 o'clock noon sharp.

The Project Coordination reserves the right not to proceed with this recruitment notice, without prejudice.

The General Director
National Employment Agency

Urbain S. AMEGBEDJI
